description.value:
Biotechnica brought the mammoth back to Siberia, and this is the souvenir. It's a walking wall with a spare heart, the same trick the herd uses to get through the winter, according to marketing.

Package: Major
Humanity Loss: 30
Includes: Exotic Bodysculpting (shaggy hide, tusks), Combat Jaw (tusks), Cyberleg ×2 w/ Fortified Ankles ×2, Dense Marrow, Grafted Muscle and Bone Lace ×2, Implanted Linear Frame Beta, Second Heart, Titanium Bones. BODY 4+ required.

Install the pieces it includes as cyberware; the package price covers them all.

Item Compendium (2070) • Cyberware
